subject: Request: Make-good credit + trial extension for BridgePath POC
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Kapoor <sanjay@bridgepath.ai>, Priya Nair <priya@bridgepath.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BridgePath POC — unexpected usage spike / request for make-good credit + extension

Sanjay / Priya,

Thanks again for running the POC with Redwood last week — it was great to see the retrieval layer and the embeddings tests you kicked off. I pulled the usage report this morning and noticed BridgePath burned through the trial credits much faster than expected (see attached metrics). A couple quick things I observed: 

- Heavy synthetic-load test on 5/17 caused long-tail embedding calls and a KV-cache miss pattern.
- Peak token rate spiked to ~1.8M tokens/day for a 48-hour window.

Given your evaluation is mid-sprint and you told us the team is still tuning prompt templates, I want to propose the following to keep the POC on track: 

1) One-time make-good credit: $5,000 applied to the account to cover the overage and give you headroom to finish tests.
2) Trial extension: 30 additional days from the current trial end date to finish the integration benchmarks.

I don’t have authority to commit credits at this level without sign-off. Monica — can you confirm if a make-good of this size is routable through a standard SA approval path, or should I escalate to Marissa for exec sign-off?

Attached: BridgePath_POC_usage_metrics.xlsx (summary + hourly token chart)

Next steps: If you’re OK with the proposed make-good + extension, I’ll loop in Marissa for approval and send a short term sheet for signatures.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Kapoor <sanjay@bridgepath.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya@bridgepath.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BridgePath POC — unexpected usage spike / request for make-good credit + extension

Aditya,

Appreciate the quick analysis and the suggested fix. Confirming the spike was from an automated load test we ran to simulate heavy user search traffic — that test should not have exhausted the trial but it did. The team is in the middle of updating prompt templates today to reduce token count.

BridgePath is absolutely fine with the make-good + extension. The 30 days would let our ML infra team finish the tuning and re-run the full retrieval tests. If you can get the short term sheet over, we’ll review and sign quickly.

Thanks — Sanjay
Sanjay Kapoor
Head of ML, BridgePath
Attachment: BP_internal_test_log_20270517.txt (log stub)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: BridgePath POC — request for make-good credit + extension (need exec approval)

Marissa / Monica,

Forwarding the thread with BridgePath — they hit an unexpected usage spike during a load test and are asking for a one-time credit + trial extension so they can finish validation. Key facts below: 

- Account: BridgePath (deal BP-2027-0531)
- Committed ARR potential: ~$180k ARR within 12 months if POC converts
- Request: $5,000 one-time credit + 30-day trial extension
- Attachments: BridgePath_POC_usage_metrics.xlsx (summary)

Monica — per our standard playbook we can usually approve up to $1,500 via SA/CS discretionary credits for POC make-goods. This ask is larger given the customer size and momentum. I recommend the following compromise if we want to avoid a full exec exception: 

Option A (preferred): Executive exception to approve $5k one-time credit + 30-day extension — signals strong commitment and preserves conversion momentum.
Option B: Approve $2k credit + 14-day extension and route a short-term premium rate for any overages after that.

BridgePath is ready to sign a short term sheet if we can confirm credit + extension. They’ve demonstrated clear intent to convert and have an eval run scheduled for the week after next.

Marissa — can you weigh in on which option you’ll greenlight? If you approve Option A I’ll prepare the redwood_makegood_term_sheet_v2.pdf and route for signature.

— Aditya
Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Kapoor <sanjay@bridgepath.ai>, Priya Nair <priya@bridgepath.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BridgePath POC — request for make-good credit + extension (approved with conditions)

Aditya / Monica / Grace —

Thanks for the context and the usage file. I approve a make-good credit of $4,000 and a 14-day trial extension (Option B, adjusted). Rationale: BridgePath is a strategic mid-market account with a high likelihood to convert, but we need to keep the concession size disciplined.

Conditions: 
1) Apply the $4,000 credit as a one-time balance on their Redwood account; expiration 90 days if not utilized.
2) Provide the 14-day extension immediately upon confirmation of signed short term sheet.
3) Sales to include a brief success plan (3 bullet points) and expected go/no-go date in the term sheet.
4) Finance must review for revenue recognition implications — Monica, please loop in BillingOps for any billing hold or invoicing notes.

Aditya — please send the redwood_makegood_term_sheet_v2.pdf to BridgePath with the updated credit value and extension period. Copy me on the DocuSign link. Monica / Grace — if this looks good, I’ll flag this as approved for the Q2 concessions tracker.

Marissa Cole
VP, North America Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_makegood_term_sheet_v2.pdf (term sheet — credit = $4,000; 14-day extension)
